newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Earthquake hits eastern Indonesia, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake hits eastern Indonesia, no casualties.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.6 on the open-ended Richter scale hit a remote coastal town in Indonesia's eastern Irian Jaya province on Friday morning, an official from the Meteorological Department in Jakarta said.
He said the earthquake rattled windows and moved furniture in Sarmi town, 40 km (25 miles) northwest of Irian Jaya's capital, Jayapura, but there were no reports of casualties or damage.
The official said the earthquake struck at 3:48 a.m. Jakarta time (2048 GMT), and its epicentre was about 190 km (118 miles) west of Jayapura.
The Royal Hong Kong Observatory had earlier said the quake measured 6.0 on the Richter.
Irian Jaya forms the western half of New Guinea island.
